tooling.message:
docs(site): the evals page becomes Prompt engineering, with how we work

## Intent

Changing the guidance and testing it fast needs a loop, and others should be able to read it: an interactive test, the evals, changes to the guidance, and an interactive test of the new guidance before it is published.

## Key changes

- The page lives at /tooling/prompt-engineering/ and describes that loop, including the orchestrating session that serves the unpublished guidance to the test session.
- /tooling/evals/ points to the new page; the report writes its data there.
